data.name: Unstable Bonds
data.description: Your touch can disrupt the bonds that hold a summoned or called creature on this plane. As a melee touch attack, you can cause a summoned or called creature to become shaken and staggered for %1 rounds. You can use this ability %2 times per day.|max(ArcanistSavantSchoolLVL/2,1)|INT+3
